'''''Hot Prospect''''' was a [[Calipsan 560 mining ship]], which was used by [[Zayne Carrick]] and his crew after the [[Vindication]].

==History==
[[File:Hot_Prospect.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Hot Prospect'' in flight]]
When [[Marn Hierogryph]] sent [[Slyssk]] to buy a new ship for the group, the latter became confused as he had never bought a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] before - only "borrowed" them. The saleslady whom Slyssk met with tricked him, saying that the ''Hot Prospect'' was a "gem" of a ship, when it was actually a gem miner. As a result Slyssk choose to buy the [[Calipsa]]n mining ship, which looked equally ugly both inside and outside. Gryph had Slyssk spend the rest of his [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] cleaning it up.

Later [[Jarael]] and [[Rohlan Dyre|Rohlan]] used the ship while traveling to [[Metellos 3]]. When Zayne finally caught up with his friends, Gryph introduced the ship to the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], to Carrick's great surprise and perplexity. The ship was later used to ferry the group to the ''[[Chancellor Fillorean]]'', [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]], [[Wor Tandell/Legends|Wor Tandell]] and, finally, the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], where it fought in a space battle against the [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']].
